title: MultiplayerSynchronizer does not handle synchronizing more than 64 properties at once
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.rc.custom_build [0e3dbba6a]
v4.4.rc3.official [15ff45068]

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc (0e3dbba6a) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

When you add more than 64 variables to single ```MultiplayerSynchronizer``` and set them to ```SceneReplicationConfig.REPLICATION_MODE_ON_CHANGE``` replication does not work for some of them. I expect at least some assertion or clear statement in the docs about such limitation.

### Steps to reproduce

Sample code is provided with MRP.  This is simple two-scene project configured to run client and server scene in separate instances. Variables from ```game_instance.gd``` singleton are set to be replicated. Server scene updates variables after button is clicked and client scene shows variables state every frame.

With this project:
1. When you change state of ```GameInstance.test1``` and ```GameInstance.test64``` variable inside ```server.gd``` data **is not replicated**.
2. When you change state of ```GameInstance.test64``` variable inside ```server.gd``` data **is not replicated**.
3. When you change state of ```GameInstance.test1``` variable inside ```server.gd``` data **is replicated**.

Without this project you need:
1. You should have basic client-server project setup.
2. Define 65 variables inside a class like this:
```
@export
var test0: int = 0
```
3. Setup MultiplayerSynchronizer and add config for each variable like this:
```
config.add_property("/root/GameInstance:test0")
config.property_set_replication_mode("/root/GameInstance:test63", SceneReplicationConfig.REPLICATION_MODE_ON_CHANGE)
```
4. Try to change values of these variables on the server and check if client receives correct update.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[testreplication.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19170889/testreplication.zip)
